- [FACT] User inquired about the impact of social media on the viewership of BBC2.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The growth of social media has had both positive and negative impacts on the viewership of BBC2.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Positive impacts include greater interaction and engagement with viewers, increasing interest in BBC2 programming.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Social media can generate buzz around popular shows or events, leading to more people tuning in.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Negative impacts include increased competition for traditional television networks, leading viewers to prefer social media for entertainment, news, and information.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] BBC2 uses social media to promote programming, share news, and engage with viewers.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] BBC2 launched successful digital campaigns, such as the "Planet Earth II" Snapchat campaign, to reach younger audiences.

- [USER] Inquired about any particular social media platform that BBC2 focuses on more than others.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] On Twitter, BBC2 posts breaking news updates, live-tweets events, and shares links to articles and videos.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] On Facebook, BBC2 shares longer-form content, including video clips, articles, and behind-the-scenes looks.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] On Instagram, BBC2 shares visually stunning images and clips related to its programming.
